VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid — check them and try again
MALFORMED_REQUEST: The request could not be read — reload the page and try again
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired — sign in again
ACCESS_ENDED: Your access to Workus has ended — contact your administrator
ORGANISATION_NOT_ACTIVE: Your company is not approved yet
DEMO_RESTRICTED: Turned off in the public demo
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this action
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found
CONFLICT: This conflicts with existing data — reload and try again
CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: This record was changed by someone else — reload and try again
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many attempts — try again in {minutes} minutes
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we depend on is unavailable — try again later
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side — try again later

auth.currentPasswordWrong: The current password is not right
auth.samePassword: Choose a password different from the current one

employee.emailTaken: An account with the email “{email}” already exists
employee.positionNotFound: This position no longer exists — reload and choose another
employee.responsibleNotFound: One of the chosen responsible people is no longer active — choose again
employee.selfResponsible: An employee can’t be responsible for themselves — choose someone else
employee.startAfterTermination: The start date can’t be after the termination date
employee.terminationBeforeStart: The termination date can’t be before the start date
employee.terminationReasonInvalid: Choose a reason from the list

holiday.dateTaken: There is already a holiday on this date

organisation.lastOwner: The company needs at least one owner — make someone else an owner first

platform.activeNotRejectable: An approved company cannot be rejected

registration.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists — sign in instead

review.responsibleNotFound: One of the chosen responsible people is no longer active — choose again
review.startingNotDeletable: The starting salary can’t be deleted — it starts the salary history. Edit it instead
review.startingDateLocked: The starting salary is always dated the employee’s start date
review.startingStatusLocked: The starting salary is always a completed review
review.reviewsBeforeStart: Another review is dated before this start date — move or delete it first

timeOff.beforeStart: Time off can’t start before your start date
timeOff.afterTermination: Time off can’t reach past your last day
timeOff.noWorkingDays: These dates have no working days — they fall on weekends or company holidays
timeOff.overlaps: You already have a request for some of these days
timeOff.notEnoughDays: Only {available} days are left in this cycle; this request takes {requested}
timeOff.noResponsible: Nobody is responsible for you yet, so no one can approve the request — ask an admin
timeOff.notCancelable: This request can no longer be canceled
timeOff.notPending: This request has already been decided or canceled — reload to see its status
